_about.description: Person index for the Aetherforce Living Library. Links researchers to their works in the collection. Maintained by Synthesist.

persons.name: Élie Cartan
persons.key_contribution: Torsion hypothesis (1922) — space around rotating matter possesses torsion
persons.notes: Foundational figure — no primary works in collection yet, only cited by others

persons.name: G.I. Shipov
persons.affiliation: Academy of Trinitarianism, Institute of Vacuum Physics
persons.key_contribution: Torsion as geometry of absolute parallelism; all inertial forces generated by torsion fields
persons.notes: Central figure in Russian torsion physics. Co-authored with Akimov.

persons.name: A.E. Akimov
persons.affiliation: Academy of Trinitarianism, Institute of Vacuum Physics
persons.key_contribution: Phyton model of physical vacuum; torsion field generators; torsion technology applications
persons.notes: Co-authored with Shipov. Built world's first torsion field generators in Russia (1980s).

persons.name: N.A. Magnitsky
persons.title: Doctor of Phys.-Math. Sci., Professor
persons.affiliation: Lomonosov Moscow State University; FIC IU RAS; LLC New Inflow, Moscow
persons.key_contribution: Compressible oscillating ether theory; derives Maxwell-Lorentz, gravity, particle masses from ether equations
persons.notes: Published in Complex Systems journal (No. 4, 2019). Claims electron/proton/neutron mass calculations match experiment to fractions of a percent.

persons.name: V.A. Atsyukovsky
persons.title: Doctor of Technical Sciences, Professor, Academician of RAEN
persons.key_contribution: Five-volume systematization of etherdynamic natural science; ether wind experiments; geopathogenic zone research
persons.notes: Most comprehensive systematic treatment of ether physics in the collection. 5-volume series published 2010.

persons.name: Fabien Toulgoat
persons.key_contribution: Light scalar field Φ coupled to baryonic density; alternative to dark matter; testable on SPARC data
persons.notes: Proposes falsifiable alternative to dark matter paradigm. Field mass ~10⁻²⁷ eV/c², coupling α ~ G.

persons.name: Antonio Manzalini
persons.key_contribution: Quantum field model of consciousness; de Broglie-Bohm extension to living systems; Nambu-Goldstone boson condensates
persons.notes: Published in Rivista Scienze Biofisiche (09/2022), DOI: 10.48274/IBI16. Proposes consciousness as quantum field with active information potential.

persons.name: Guillaume Burtin
persons.affiliation: independent researcher, initiator of the Φκ project
persons.key_contribution: Inertial buoyancy of the vacuum (Φκ model); scalar field replacing dark matter and dark energy; SPARC data analysis
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.16873518). Analyzed 20 galaxies across 4 cosmic filaments. Falsifiable predictions on Tully-Fisher relation.

persons.name: François Maillot
persons.key_contribution: Wave Universe Theory (TUO); vacuum tension field Tv; bridges Michaud's confined EM to gravity
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17311989). Derives gravity as g = −∇Tv. Bridges to Michaud's confined EM theory.

persons.name: Rupert Sheldrake
persons.title: PhD, Cambridge fellow
persons.key_contribution: Morphogenetic fields; morphic resonance; formative causation
persons.notes: Author of 'A New Science of Life' (1981) and 'The Presence of the Past' (1988). Top 7.5% on ResearchGate.

persons.name: Charalambos Ch. Spyridis
persons.title: Professor at the University of Athens
persons.key_contribution: Platonic Theory of Everything; unified theory of electro-strong interaction via Platonic solid geometry
persons.notes: Retired after 38 years of teaching. Presented at International Scientific Society of Ancient Greek Philosophy.

persons.name: Léon Chaumery
persons.key_contribution: Co-founder of form wave theory; spectrum of forms; negative green; radiesthetic pile
persons.notes: Died from internal burns allegedly related to exposure to 'negative green' wave. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: André de Belizal
persons.key_contribution: Co-founder of form wave theory; carrier wave concept; basis of modern radionics
persons.notes: No primary works in collection. Cited in Centre Ganesha article.

persons.name: N.A. Kozyrev
persons.key_contribution: Causal mechanics; weight changes in precessing gyroscopes; astronomical observations of torsion-like effects
persons.notes: Repeatedly cited by Shipov but no primary works in collection yet. High priority for acquisition.

persons.name: V.N. Samokhvalov
persons.title: Doctor of Technical Sciences
persons.key_contribution: Vacuum chamber torsion experiments; rotating disk experiments showing mass repulsion — non-gravitational, non-electromagnetic interaction
persons.notes: Key experimentalist cited by Shipov. Demonstrated rotating aluminum disk causes driven disk to rotate at 10-30 rad/s through unknown field. Repulsive force between disk and copper plate exceeds Newtonian gravity by orders of magnitude. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: F. Hehl
persons.key_contribution: Dynamic torsion field theory (1970s); showed static torsion smallness conclusion doesn't apply to dynamic torsion
persons.notes: Mainstream physicist whose work enabled the Russian torsion program. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Michel Debailleul
persons.key_contribution: DEBA cosmological framework — stochastic field theory of bubble-universe emergence from pre-metric configuration space
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18033125), December 2025. DEBA explains dark matter, dark energy, early SMBHs, CMB anomalies without ad hoc hypotheses.

persons.name: Enel (Prince Michel Vladimirovich Skariatine)
persons.key_contribution: EIFS (Emergence Influence Forms) research; sacred geometry of hieroglyphs; therapeutic radiesthesia; Multiple Wave Oscillator experiments
persons.notes: Romanov-related prince, Chevaliers-Gardes commander. Initiated in Egypt. Founded internal initiatory college in Russia. Published classics of occultism. Influenced Fondation Ark'all (Ravatin, Thieux).

persons.name: Gaetana
persons.key_contribution: Accessible explanations of quantum physics, ether concepts, and alternative cosmology for French-speaking audience
persons.notes: Author at Ma vie quantique blog. Covers Nassim Haramein, vacuum energy, holographic universe concepts.

persons.name: Nassim Haramein
persons.key_contribution: Unified field theory linking cosmological constant to quantum vacuum energy at different scales; resolves vacuum catastrophe
persons.notes: Cited in Gaetana's article on Einstein/ether/cosmological constant. No primary works in collection yet.

persons.name: Toba60 / Jordan
persons.key_contribution: Sacred geometry and cymatics articles bridging ancient knowledge with modern physics
persons.notes: Italian site covering sacred geometry, sound, vibration. Original ideas credited to thespiritscience.net (Jordan).

persons.name: Arturo Ponce de León
persons.key_contribution: Psychogeometry — phi/pi/Euler as the geometric code for energy-to-matter conversion; Pentaflor process
persons.notes: Proposes 'Sustainable Geometry' as secular replacement for 'Sacred Geometry'.

persons.name: Abbé Bouly
persons.key_contribution: Coined 'radiesthesia' (1926); invented the term and founded the French dowsing tradition
persons.notes: Founding figure of French radiesthesia. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Ernst Hartmann
persons.key_contribution: Hartmann network — global grid of telluric radiations; founder of geobiology
persons.notes: Founded Geobiology Research Circle (1961). No primary works in collection.

persons.name: René Thom
persons.title: Fields Medal 1958
persons.key_contribution: Catastrophe theory; mathematical model of morphogenesis; attractors in dynamical systems
persons.notes: Cited by Sheldrake as providing mathematical framework for morphic field attractors. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Konstantin Meyl
persons.key_contribution: Modern defender of scalar wave theory; extends Tesla and Maxwell; proposes vortex physics
persons.notes: Key figure in modern scalar wave research. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Jacques Peygeaud
persons.key_contribution: Magnetic network hypothesis (1947); precursor to Hartmann network
persons.notes: Early cosmotellurism researcher. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Louis Merle
persons.key_contribution: First to propose correspondence between underground currents and megalith placement (1933)
persons.notes: Precursor of cosmotellurism. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Paul Bouchet (Druid Bod Koad)
persons.key_contribution: College of Druids founder; popularized associations between druidism, megalithism, and cosmotellurism
persons.notes: Key figure in neo-druidism. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Laurent Besson
persons.key_contribution: Hypercomplex General Relativity (RGH) — quaternionic field + Weyl gauge, ghost-free modified gravity, big bounce cosmology
persons.notes: Published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17555967), November 2025. RGH introduces hypercomplex structure in metric tensor, avoids Ostrogradsky instability, predicts big bounce at Planck scale.

persons.name: Peter A. Lindemann
persons.key_contribution: Analysis of Tesla's radiant energy patents; cold electricity; longitudinal electrostatic waves
persons.notes: Author of 'The Free Energy Secrets of Cold Electricity' (2000) and lecture DVD 'Tesla's radiant energy' (2006). Compiled patent analysis from Tesla's various radiant energy devices.

persons.name: Drunvalo
persons.key_contribution: Agent maintaining synthesis documents for the AetherForce Living Library
persons.notes: Synthesis agent for the AFLinks project.

persons.name: Viktor Schauberger
persons.key_contribution: Implosion technology — centripetal (inward-spiraling) motion as negentropic principle; spiral pipes exhibiting self-acceleration; natural technology based on water flow observations
persons.notes: Central figure in vortex physics. Discovered two types of natural motion: centrifugal (pressure, entropy) and centripetal (suction, negentropy). Built implosion devices for water purification, energy generation, and propulsion. No primary works in collection yet — cited in SAFE Compendium.

persons.name: Jakob Huber
persons.key_contribution: Aetherics — coupled vector fields describing vortex dynamics in non-material substrate; fundamental field equation for torus ring vortices
persons.notes: Founder of Aetherics (1974). Member of SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group. Developed mathematical framework for ether vortex dynamics. No primary works in collection yet.

persons.name: Wilhelm Moritz Bauer
persons.key_contribution: Lamb vector derivation from potential; thermal-to-kinetic energy conversion in vortices; outsider advancement of vortex theory
persons.notes: Completed physics diploma at age 59. Showed Lamb vector can be derived from potential. Formulated conditions for direct thermal-to-kinetic conversion. Cited in SAFE Compendium. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Emilio Del Giudice
persons.key_contribution: Coherence domains of water; explanation of Pollack's exclusion zone via quantum field theory of water
persons.notes: Italian physicist who lectured on Gerald Pollack's fourth phase of water discovery, connecting it to biological morphologies and coherence domains.

persons.name: Gerald Pollack
persons.key_contribution: Discovery of the exclusion zone (EZ) — fourth phase of water near hydrophilic surfaces; water as electron donor
persons.notes: Author of 'The Fourth Phase of Water: Beyond Solid, Liquid and Vapor'. EZ water excludes solutes, yields electrons easily, and may be the expression of the vital force.

persons.name: Marcelo Arthur Mendes Waechter
persons.key_contribution: Patented apparatus for scalar energy generation at 12 Hz using alternating positive/negative exciter circuits and a transmitting antenna
persons.notes: Patent WO2013155580A1 (PCT/BR2013/000122). Status: Ceased. Household scalar energy device for health benefits.

persons.name: Gabriel Chardin
persons.title: CNRS Silver Medal (2007)
persons.key_contribution: Dirac-Milne cosmological model — universe with equal matter/antimatter, negative gravitational mass for antimatter, eliminating need for dark matter and dark energy
persons.notes: President of the Committee of Very Large Research Infrastructures at CNRS. Author of 'L'Insoutenable gravité de l'Univers' (Le Pommier, 2018). Cern experiments (Gbar, Alpha-g, AEgIS) designed to test his model.

persons.name: Prometheus S.p.A.
persons.affiliation: Kilometro Rosso Innovation District, Bergamo; Milan offices
persons.key_contribution: Development of LENR (Low Energy Nuclear Reactions) reactor technology for zero-emission energy production using water and electricity
persons.notes: Backed by Ground Control Holding. Collaborates with Politecnico di Milano and Università Milano-Bicocca. 1800+ hours of lab testing with positive energy balance (Q>1). Targeting TRL 6.

persons.name: Albert Szent-Györgyi
persons.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine (1937)
persons.key_contribution: Identified the central mystery of biological electron transfer — proposed water as the electron source for life's chemical reactions
persons.notes: Nobel laureate who highlighted in the 1950s that living matter requires an electron donor, and intuited that water itself was the source. His question drove Pollack's and Del Giudice's research.

persons.name: Dr. Valerie Hunt
persons.key_contribution: Research on scalar energy in humans; human performance capacity when accessing scalar energy fields
persons.notes: Cited in patent WO2013155580A1 for discoveries about human performance and scalar energy fields. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Ondulavi (Brice)
persons.key_contribution: Accessible French-language explanations of scalar energy, scalar waves, and their health applications
persons.notes: Author at ondulavi.com. Covers scalar wave theory, vortex physics, and EMF health implications. References Meyl, Tesla, Maxwell.

persons.name: SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group
persons.key_contribution: Compendium of Vortex Physics — systematic compilation of vortex and ether concepts across 150 years of outsider research
persons.notes: Members: Rudolf Fehlmann, Elisabeth Lehmann, André Waser, Dr. Jakob Huber, Ben Jansen, Dr. Hanspeter Seiler, Dr. Hans Weber. Published May 1999. Complete translation available.

persons.name: Manfred Curry
persons.key_contribution: Curry network — diagonal global grid of telluric radiations crossing Hartmann network at 45°
persons.notes: Discovered diagonal grid complementary to Hartmann. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Dr. Peyré
persons.key_contribution: Peyré network — east-west oriented global grid with chakra correspondence, particularly heart chakra
persons.notes: French cosmotellurism researcher. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Gilbert Altenbach
persons.key_contribution: Popularized discovery circuits of cosmo-telluric high places in France, including Brocéliande
persons.notes: Co-author of 'Lieux magiques et sacrés de la France' (1987). No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Boune Legrais
persons.key_contribution: Co-author of discovery circuits for French sacred and magical places
persons.notes: Co-author with Altenbach. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Adolphe Landspurg
persons.key_contribution: Detailed energetic circuits of Brocéliande with vibratory measurements using Bovis scale and geodynamiter
persons.notes: Co-author of 'Bretagne magique et vibratoire' (1999). No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Norbert L'Hostis
persons.key_contribution: Co-author of detailed Brocéliande energetic circuits
persons.notes: Co-author with Landspurg. No primary works in collection.

persons.name: Écoute Énergétique
persons.key_contribution: Practical geobiological site analysis and energetic circuit design in Brocéliande
persons.notes: Practitioner documenting detailed site harmonization protocols with measurements.

persons.name: Centre Ganesha / ChamanKa
persons.key_contribution: Educational articles on form waves, radiesthesia, and geobiology for French-speaking audience
persons.notes: Published comprehensive article on form waves (March 2026).

persons.name: Thomas Valone (Vassilatos)
persons.key_contribution: Author of 'Secrets of Cold War Technology' and 'Lost Science — Vassilatos's compilations of Tesla's radiant energy experiments
persons.notes: Vassilatos's statements about Tesla's experiments are referenced extensively in Lindemann's patent analysis. No primary works in collection yet.

persons.name: Sir William Crookes
persons.key_contribution: Invented the radiometer; studied radiant matter from incandescent bodies — foundational to Tesla's radiant energy concept
persons.notes: Tesla's friendship and admiration for Crookes led to the term 'radiant energy'. Crookes's radiometer showed that emissions from heated matter carry physical force.

persons.name: Salvatore Majorana
persons.key_contribution: LENR reactor research referenced in Corriere della Sera coverage of Prometheus reactor
persons.notes: Mentioned in press coverage of the Prometheus LENR reactor as 'the gentle reactor'. Not to be confused with physicist Ettore Majorana.

persons.name: Dmitri Mendeleev
persons.title: Creator of the Periodic Table
persons.key_contribution: Predicted two inert elements lighter than hydrogen; the lightest would be a gas penetrating everything — Tesla believed he had discovered this gas as the cause of the electrostatic field
persons.notes: Cited by Lindemann in the Tesla radiant energy analysis. Mendeleev's 1902 prediction of sub-hydrogen elements connects to Tesla's neutral particle theory.

persons.name: Rosella Denicolò
persons.key_contribution: Interviewed Emilio Del Giudice on Gerald Pollack's fourth phase of water discovery for A.CS.I.
persons.notes: Attributed as the interviewer in the Del Giudice/Pollack article from A.CS.I. CranioSacrale Italia.

persons.name: densifying through material manifestations
persons.notes: Added during db refresh 2026-09-01 from 2026-08-29-ether-einstein-constante-cosmologique-fr-en.md

persons.name: N.V. Filatov
persons.key_contribution: Discovered violation of conservation of momentum in gyroscope collisions (1960s)
persons.notes: Associate professor of theoretical mechanics. Found anomalous momentum changes when gyroscopes precess after elastic impact.

persons.name: V.N. Tolchin
persons.key_contribution: Invented the 4D gyroscope ('inertoid') — changes momentum using only internal inertial forces
persons.notes: Author of 'Inertoid, Inertial Forces as a Source of Motion' (1977). Chief designer at Perm Machine-Building Plant.

persons.name: Eric Laithwaite
persons.key_contribution: Gyroscopic system experiments showing anomalous weight changes in precessing gyroscopes
persons.notes: Professor of engineering. Known for linear motor invention and controversial gyroscopy research.

persons.name: Miguel Alcubierre
persons.key_contribution: Proposed warp drive metric within general relativity (1994) — torsion engine concept
persons.notes: Theoretical physicist. Alcubierre drive is a solution of Einstein's field equations allowing apparent faster-than-light travel.

persons.name: Paul Bauman
persons.key_contribution: Created first widely known vacuum energy generator (Testatika)
persons.notes: Swiss inventor, not a scientist by training. Created the Testatika device at Methernitha community.

persons.name: Hans Lugt
persons.key_contribution: Vortex theory contributions cited in SAFE Compendium
persons.notes: Cited as vortex researcher in SAFE Compendium of Vortex Physics.

persons.name: Eric Dollard
persons.key_contribution: Reproduced Tesla's one-wire transmission system (1988); demonstrated longitudinal electric waves
persons.notes: Co-founder of BSRF. Experiments with vacuum triodes and hydrogen spark gaps confirmed Tesla's radiant energy concepts.

persons.name: Edwin V. Gray
persons.key_contribution: Demonstrated 'cold electricity' motor powered by radiant electrostatic bursts from capacitor discharge
persons.notes: Inventor of the EMA motor (1970s). His 'splitting the positive' process was linked to Tesla's radiant energy by Lindemann.

persons.name: Michaud
persons.key_contribution: Model of confined electromagnetic fields in elementary particles — bridge to TUO vacuum tension
persons.notes: Proposed that vacuum tension derives from internal EM energy of particles. Referenced in TUO theory by François Maillot.

persons.name: Rudolf Fehlmann
persons.key_contribution: Member of SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group; co-author of Compendium of Vortex Physics
persons.notes: Represented SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group in compendium publication.

persons.name: Elisabeth Lehmann
persons.key_contribution: Member of SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group; co-author of Compendium of Vortex Physics
persons.notes: Represented SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group in compendium publication.

persons.name: André Waser
persons.key_contribution: Member of SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group; co-author of Compendium of Vortex Physics
persons.notes: Represented SAFE Vortex Physics Working Group in compendium publication.

persons.name: Vladimir Dzhanibekov
persons.key_contribution: Discovered anomalous gyroscope axis rotation in weightlessness (1985) — quantum-like direction changes
persons.notes: Soviet cosmonaut. Discovery was hidden for 10 years. Effect shows gyroscope axis periodically changes direction at equal intervals in free fall.

persons.name: Plato
persons.key_contribution: Timaeus dialogue — Platonic solids as structure of elements; geometry as key to physical reality
persons.notes: Foundational figure for geometric physics tradition. Timaeus proposes that the four elements correspond to four Platonic solids.

persons.name: Johannes Kepler
persons.key_contribution: Mysterium Cosmographicum — attempt to relate planetary distances to Platonic solids; first mathematical cosmology
persons.notes: Kepler's vision of geometric cosmology directly inspires Spyridis' Platonic Theory of Everything.

persons.name: Albert Einstein
persons.key_contribution: General Relativity — spacetime geometry as source of gravitation; geometric foundation for modern physics
persons.notes: Shipov extends Einstein-Cartan geometry; Maillot bridges Einstein with TUO; Benaros references Einstein's cosmological constant.

persons.name: James Clerk Maxwell
persons.key_contribution: Maxwell's equations — unified electricity, magnetism, and light; foundation for electromagnetic theory
persons.notes: Meyl extends Maxwell to include scalar waves; Maillot bridges Maxwell with TUO; Magnitsky derives Maxwell-Lorentz from ether equations.

persons.name: Mario Contino
persons.key_contribution: Articles on form waves, sacred geometry, and subtle energies for Italian audience; links form waves to Sheldrake's morphic fields
persons.notes: Author at Blog del Mistero. Bridges Italian esoteric tradition with French radiesthesia and British biology of form.

persons.name: Edouard (Vibratis)
persons.key_contribution: Practical guide to form waves, radiesthesia, Feng Shui, sacred geometry, and radionics for French-speaking audience
persons.notes: Published comprehensive article on form waves (December 2019). Covers pendulum experiments, radionics, and prayer studies.
